description: This Java source file defines the JTableChooser class, which extends JOptionPane and implements MouseListener, providing a graphical user interface component for selecting a Table object from a tree view of ROM images and their associated tables. It constructs a hierarchical tree of ROMs and tables, displays it in a dialog, and returns the selected Table.

classes.name: JTableChooser
classes.description: A GUI dialog component for selecting a Table object from a tree view of ROM images and tables.

methods.name: showChooser
methods.description: Displays a dialog allowing the user to select a Table from loaded ROM images and returns the selected Table.

methods.name: mouseReleased
methods.description: Handles the mouse released event to adjust the tree view size.
